name: x_rules_multiball_lockout_1
description: rules mode, 2 balls: ball 0 from diagonal_wall_hit, slot 1 from multi_bounce_upper. EP9-13 keep one sensor lockout per ball (ds:3880+2i, copied into ds:388b around each ball's pixel scan and decremented per frame per slot); a lockout set by one ball's handler must not block the other ball's sensors. The port with a single lockout diverges at record 24 (extra.layer).
